description: Free. Check an x402 seller before you pay it: pass url (the resource you are about to buy), domain, or payTo (the address in its 402 quote, case-insensitive). Lumi ingests the full CDP x402 Bazaar catalog daily and runs free, unpaid 402-quote checks of listings on a rotating schedule (valid quote, price and payTo vs the listing, latency, domain age; live coverage counts in the response), labelled 'quote-checked, low confidence', plus Lumi's own test-buys confirmed on-chain, labelled 'test-bought' and counted per chain (Base USDC buys of Bazaar listings; XRPL buys of a small curated list, separately). Answer-only: tx evidence is in the paid trust check. Observations, not ratings; no match is not a negative finding. With no arguments: the curated XRPL vendor scores and catalog counts; vendor_id gives one curated vendor's summary (tx evidence is in the paid vendor report).

domain.description: Seller host or domain, e.g. example.com

payTo.description: payTo address from the seller's 402 quote (0x... or r...)

url.description: Resource URL you are about to pay, e.g. https://example.com/api/data

vendor_id.description: Optional curated vendor id, e.g. printmoneylab

name: lumi_vendor_scores
title: Lumi: x402 vendor observations (free)
